about: The square you crop a profile photo to, in the photo's pixels from its top-left; rectangles are [x, y, width, height] and sizes [width, height]. centered: the frame a photo opens with, the largest square in the middle. moved: the frame dragged by an offset, stopping at the photo's edges. resized: one corner dragged by an offset while the opposite corner stays put; the frame stays square and inside the photo, and never shrinks below a quarter of the photo's short side.

centered.name: A wide photo crops its middle
A tall photo crops its middle

moved.name: A drag inside the photo moves the frame as far
A drag past the top-right stops at its edges
A drag past the bottom-left stops at its edges

resized.name: The top-left corner grows the frame around the bottom-right
Growing stops where the photo ends
The top-right corner grows the frame around the bottom-left
Shrinking stops at a quarter of the short side
The smallest frame shrinks no further
